parameters.name: EnableInstallAgentNewECS
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically install the CloudMonitor agent on new ECS instances. Valid values:

*   true (default): The CloudMonitor agent is automatically installed on new ECS instances.
*   false: The CloudMonitor agent is not automatically installed on new ECS instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms put-monitoring-config --auto-install true --enable-install-agent-new-ecs true --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms PutMonitoringConfig --region cn-hangzhou --AutoInstall true --EnableInstallAgentNewECS true
